title: Soul Drifter
description:
Soul Drifter is an atmospheric single-player first-person platformer set in a surreal underwater world.

You’re a fallen angel in an unfamiliar world. Master your skills to save captive souls in this atmospheric adventure.

Gravity-Defying ParkourSoar into heart-pounding parkour runs on courses only possible for someone with wings. Rack up airtime as you glide across vast chasms, dash through obstacles, and flap your wings for a powerful double jump. String together moves and enter a flow state in which you’ll barely need to touch the ground. Just manage your stamina carefully — there’s nothing to catch you if you fall. 

Master the MachinesTake on fast-paced parkour courses that put your new skills to the test. Muster your courage to enter the final challenge of each level — a massive factory that will challenge both your movement accuracy and reaction time.

 

Explore Strange LandscapesStep into a surreal, unfamiliar world. Encounter wide open underwater vistas, narrow factory corridors, and towering structures meant to communicate with the gods. Why are other souls kept imprisoned here — and what did their captors intend to do with them?

Features• Glide through the air by mastering the stamina system

• Activate special moves like dashes and double jumps

• Explore levels in a great variety of different biomes, from natural vistas to dangerous factories

• Collect hidden data tablets to learn more about the strange world you've landed in

• Defeat difficult "boss" levels at the end of each area to save your friends
description_short: Soar into a gravity-defying parkour adventure. Run, jump, and glide through surreal landscapes and deadly factories on a mission to liberate captive souls.
